title: Hearty Gooey Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A slow-cooked lamb dish with a rich, gooey sauce featuring oyster sauce and Middle Eastern spices, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the oyster sauce, dates, and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven.
Cook the tagine at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce is thick and gooey.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
